title: Trustworthy AI for Low-Carbon Geopolymers: Research Artifact (screening ledger, coded corpus, keyword classifier, audit tables)
description:
Research artifact for the systematic review From Property Prediction to Clean-Technology Deployment: A Systematic Review and Roadmap for Trustworthy AI in Low-Carbon Geopolymer Development (revised manuscript submitted to Clean Technologies and Environmental Policy).

Contents: screening ledger with per-record decision codes; the frozen core corpus (729 records; 728 after one post-freeze removal; 669 unique primary studies with 59 duplicate reports flagged); duplicate-audit evidence; the deterministic keyword classifier with its lexicon and per-record output; the physics-integration audit (32 studies) and carbon/LCA audit (77 studies); blind-recode worksheets; full-text extraction files; machine-readable supplementary tables; protocol and search log; and the revised submission.

v1.2.1 corrects the DOI and repository address cited inside the files; data, code and results are identical to v1.2.

v1.2 aligns the artifact with the revised manuscript and includes the amendment of 12 Nov 2026, which flagged seven further duplicate reports (analysis set 669 studies, previously 676); AMENDMENT_2026-11-12.md lists every affected number. See CHANGELOG.md for changes since v1.1 and README.md for known gaps.
